beats.line: leading you directly into a section called the restriction
in this area it is so tight divers must
unclip air tanks from their backs and haul
them at their sides just to squeeze through the rock
now thankfully we have all done this once before
so experience should play a factor
the following section is terrifying because
it looks exactly the same in either direction
if you lose focus or get disoriented even for a single second
you can completely lose track of which way you came from
